topics.name: 文化遗产
topics.description: 认读 heritage、temple、preserve 和 relic。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「遗产」？

topics.name: 保护文物
topics.description: 认读 restore、damage、ancient 和 site。
mastery_criteria: 能选出单词或短语的中文意思
能根据中文选出英文单词或短语

example.question: 哪个单词的意思是「修复」？

topics.name: 非限制性定语从句
topics.description: 能用逗号加上 who 或 which 补充说明，而不用 that。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: My brother, ___ lives in Luoyang, is a guide. 横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: which 指代整句
topics.description: 能用 which 指代前面整个句子，并和限制性定语从句区分。
mastery_criteria: 能选出语法正确的词或句子
能说明这个结构在句中做什么

example.question: He missed the train, ___ made him late. 横线处填哪一个？

topics.name: 讨论保护遗产
topics.description: 能就保护文化遗产交换看法并说明理由。
mastery_criteria: 能选出符合情境的英文句子
能读懂这个功能句在问什么或在说什么

example.question: 想说古庙应该被保护，哪一句合适？
example.answer: I think the ancient temple should be preserved

topics.name: 读遗产说明
topics.description: 读一段遗产说明，概括作者是在介绍规则还是在反对保护。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: The old city wall is part of the local heritage. Workers are restoring a gate that was damaged by rain. Visitors may take photos but must not touch the relics. 城墙属于什么？

topics.name: 写保护建议
topics.description: 能按要点选出建议短文中的句子。
mastery_criteria: 能根据短文选出与文字一致的信息
能选出和写作要点一致的句子

example.question: 要点：城墙是遗产、雨水造成损坏、游客不要触摸。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: The wall is heritage, rain damaged it, and visitors must not touch the relics

topics.name: 讨论动物保护

topics.name: 读动物保护短文
topics.description: 读一段动物保护短文，找出过去的状况和现在的措施。

example.question: The Tibetan antelope was once endangered. Now the animals are being protected on the plain. Visitors are interested in the reserve but must not feed the wildlife. 藏羚羊曾经处于什么状态？

topics.name: 写保护海报句

example.question: 要点：物种曾经濒危、现在正在被保护、不要喂食。哪一句三个要点都有？
example.answer: This species was endangered, it is being protected now, and please do not feed it

questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句里，指人作主语用 who，不用 that。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The temple, ___ was built in the Tang Dynasty, is famous. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句指物用 which，不用 that。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句是正确的？
questions.explain: 逗号后面的非限制性从句用 which。
options: The site, that we visited, is ancient
The site which, we visited is ancient
The site, which we visited, is ancient
The site, who we visited, is ancient

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 非限制性定语从句去掉以后，主句还成立吗？
questions.explain: 非限制性从句是附加说明，去掉后主句意思仍然完整。
options: 主句仍然成立，从句只是补充

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He missed the train, ___ made him late. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: which 指代 missed the train 整件事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句里的 which 指代前面整句？
questions.explain: 逗号后的 which 指忘记车票这件事。
options: The ticket which she forgot was blue
The boy who forgot it is Tom
She forgot the ticket, which was a pity
This is the train which was late

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: They restored the site, ___ took three years. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: which 指代修复遗址这件事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句不能把 that 换成指代整句的 which？
questions.explain: The relic that we saw 里的 that 指 relic，不是整句。
options: The relic that we saw is small
Rain came, which stopped the work
He was late, which annoyed the guide
The bridge fell, which shocked everyone

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说古庙应该被保护，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: should be preserved 用来表达应该保护。
options: I thinks the ancient temple should be preserved
I not think the ancient temple should be preserved
I think the ancient temple should be preserved
I think the ancient temple should be preserve

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想说明损坏来自游客乱刻，哪一句合适？

The damage comes from visitors cut the walls
The damage comes from visitors cutting the walls

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 对方认为修复太贵，你部分同意，应回答什么？
questions.explain: 部分同意可以说 I see your point, but。
options: I see your point, but the site is worth it
I see your point, but the site are worth it
I see you point, but the site is worth it
I see your point, but the site is worthy it

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 想建议设立参观规则，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 提建议用 We could make rules。
options: We could maked rules for visitors
We could make rules for visitors
We could to make rules for visitors
We could makes rules for visitors

questions.subject: english

questions.subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要点：城墙是遗产、雨水造成损坏、游客不要触摸。哪一句三个要点都有？

questions.subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 哪一句适合作为建议的第一句？
